context: A boss reviews a quarterly returns dashboard with his manager
purpose: Teach: 入金/返品/善意/純正/上旬/室長/命題/広範

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 室長、四月上旬の返品データはまとまりましたか。
lines.en: Section Chief, is the early-April returns data ready?
lines.style: Direct opening question from boss reviewing quarterly numbers with manager.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、主要カテゴリの数字を広範に集計して載せております。
lines.en: Yes, I've broadly compiled the figures for the main categories.
lines.style: Polite professional response presenting prepared dashboard materials clearly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 返品率がやけに高いな。純正部品の不具合か?
lines.en: The return rate is unusually high. Is it a genuine-parts defect?
lines.style: Sharp probing follow-up showing concern over the spiking numbers.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 純正の方は問題なく、入金処理の遅延が一因のようです。
lines.en: The genuine parts are fine; delayed payment processing seems partly to blame.
lines.style: Measured analytical reply pointing to the root cause clearly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 入金確認の仕組み改善は、うちの古い命題だな。
lines.en: Improving the payment-confirmation system is a long-running issue for us.
lines.style: Wry resigned remark acknowledging a long-standing structural workplace issue.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、お客様の多くは善意で待ってくださっているので、丁寧に対応すべきかと。
lines.en: Yes, most customers are waiting in good faith, so we should respond carefully.
lines.style: Cautious advisory tone urging consideration for patient blameless customers.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: わかった。来月上旬までに改善案を出してくれ。
lines.en: Understood. Submit an improvement proposal by early next month.
lines.style: Decisive closing instruction setting a concrete deadline for action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。経理と連携して進めます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll proceed in coordination with accounting.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgement confirming next steps with the relevant teams.
